lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately six vertical columns within the primary field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a localized lattice pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature characterized by a sharp luminance transition (light upper edge, shadowed lower edge) extending along the superior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance elongated feature is visible attached to the ventral region, representing a secondary biological entity (remora) rather than an anatomical feature of the primary subject.
